response.original_title: Hasta que la verdad los separe
response.overview: Elio and Maia are lifelong friends who work together at a radio station on the brink of bankruptcy. When their aunt and uncle Angie and Riky, eccentric millionaires, announce that they are looking for an heir to their media empire among those who embody the traditional values they champion, the two decide to pass themselves off as a happily married couple. Over a weekend at a luxurious mansion, they face power games, rivals willing to do anything and feelings that begin to blur with the charade.
response.title: Hasta que la verdad los separe
